catalogues.name: Media Cloud Directory
catalogues.documentedScale: Official directory page states over 25,000 media sources and curated collections covering over 100 countries; observed 2026-10-23, not independently recounted.
catalogues.use: Discover additional regional or topical publishers, then verify each original publisher and article before use.
catalogues.limitations: No bulk import, login, API credentials or API request tested. External directory entries are not included in sources.json counts, editorial trust decisions or reuse permissions. Directory/search tools may require an account and their current conditions must be checked before integration.

catalogues.name: ReliefWeb Sources / UN OCHA
catalogues.documentedScale: Official sources documentation states more than 1,000 organizations; observed 2026-10-23, not independently recounted.
catalogues.use: Discover humanitarian and development publishers; source metadata includes names, homepages, organization types, country and status.
catalogues.limitations: No live API request, full pagination, registration or app-name configuration tested. Defaults can include inactive organizations; filter status and verify current publishing activity. A headquarters country is not the geographic scope of every report. Original publisher, role, evidence and rights still require checking.

catalogues.name: GDELT DOC / discovery tools
catalogues.documentedScale: 2017-06-20 DOC 2.0 announcement describes cross-language news discovery. No current source count or current quota is asserted.
catalogues.use: Find event coverage and original publisher URLs beyond the curated pool, then read original sources.
catalogues.limitations: Documentation is historical. Endpoint availability, limits and current conditions were not live-tested. Machine translation, tone labels and proximity are discovery aids, not lexicographic or factual authority. No full-text redistribution licence follows from indexing.
